# has sub-event

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasSubEvent`](gmeow-hasSubEvent.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasSubEvent>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an event to a constituent sub-event; the transitive inverse of [`gmeow:subEventOf`](gmeow-subEventOf.md).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) -> [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when traversing or projecting from a whole event to its constituent sub-events — a conference rooted view listing its sessions and talks.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting it directly when [`gmeow:subEventOf`](gmeow-subEventOf.md) reads more naturally (prefer the part→whole direction and let the inverse follow), and avoid confusing it with the temporal [`gmeow:contains`](gmeow-contains.md).

### How to use

- Prefer asserting [`gmeow:subEventOf`](gmeow-subEventOf.md) and read [`gmeow:hasSubEvent`](gmeow-hasSubEvent.md) as its transitive inverse; reach for it explicitly only in whole-rooted projections.

### Examples

- ex:conference [`gmeow:hasSubEvent`](gmeow-hasSubEvent.md) ex:session.
